BrochureContent.Content:
Halnon Humphreys Estate Agents are excited to bring to the market this remarkable four bedroom residence, located in a much sought after coastal area.
The light filled and generous family home, which was built c. 2002, extends to approximately 170 sq. m. and sits on a mature site measuring approximately 0.45 acres. 
The residence is approached by a stone wall entrance and tarmacadam driveway with a maturely planted roundabout offering privacy and lawned gardens to the front and rear enclosed garden. There is parking for several cars to the front of the property, and the rear garden is enclosed with timber gates. A concrete patio lies to the side of the property of the dining area/kitchen, ideal for alfresco dining and it enjoys sunshine from early afternoon, with the sun setting to the rear. Additionally, there is a large concrete area to the rear of the property  
This fabulous property is presented in turnkey condition and is ready for immediate occupation.
Location:
The property's appeal is further enhanced by its superb location. Ideally positioned within easy reach of Ballygarrett, Kilmuckridge, Gorey, and Courtown, with a wide range of local amenities, recreational facilities, sporting clubs, and coastal attractions. Both beautiful beaches Cahore and Old Bawn are less than a 5 minute drive from the property.Wexford Town Centre is a 30 minute drive and south Dublin is a 60 minute commute.

The ground floor of this beautiful coastal home offers a large and welcoming entrance hallway. There is a fourth bedroom with bay window, living room with inset stove and bay window, kitchen/dining room leading to a large conservatory and patio area, utility room, W.C. and a second living room with an elegant open fire marble fireplace.
The first floor offers a bright landing area, extensive master bedroom with a generous ensuite bathroom and walk-in wardrobe, a family bathroom, and two further double bedrooms.    
The high ceilings and spacious living areas through this property promote an abundance of natural light.

Located in a sought after coastal area
Less than a 5 minute drive to Cahore Strand & Old Bawn Beach
60 minute commute to south Dublin
15 minute drive to Gorey 
Turn-key condition & spacious throughout 
Generous and mature gardens with patio area and ample parking

Services:
Oil fired central heating
High speed broadband is available in the area
Private sewage 
Mains water
